links.comparator_used: Traditional single-threshold conversion of model outputs to class predictions for all patients
links.effect: Single threshold accuracy 84.5%; double threshold accuracy 92.2% on the 80.7% of patients with the highest-confidence predictions
links.tradeoff: About 19.3% of patients were left with uncertain predictions that the model did not classify confidently.
links.quote: Traditional thresholding produced an accuracy of 84.5%, while the double threshold approach yielded 92.2% accuracy on the 80.7% of patients with the highest confidence predictions.

links.comparator_used: Random forest models trained on radiomic features alone or clinical features alone
links.effect: Combined RF AUC 0.925 vs radiomic-only 0.863 and clinical-only 0.889
links.quote: The combined RF (AUC: 0.925) outperformed the RFs trained on radiomic (AUC: 0.863) or clinical (AUC: 0.889) features alone.
